title: Legacy exports with empty format fields break leaderboard generation
description: A set of committed February 2026 exports had empty gameType and deckType strings. The v6/v7 schemas only required those fields to exist as strings, and older readers treated empty deckType as commander. After reader-side backfills were removed, make leaderboard and make website started crashing on these files. Fixes should repair the bad exports, require non-empty format fields in schema/runtime validation, and make CI run leaderboard generation so future regressions fail before merge.
